messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected — elevated packet loss and route withdrawals for customer PrivateLink/VPC-peering traffic in us-west-2a. Alert threshold hit (p50 latency up 3x, 20% packet loss). Pager fired to on-call.

sre_oncall_jordan: Acknowledged. I'm on it. Starting triage — collecting infra and peering state. @neteng_lina can you standby for BGP/peering checks?

neteng_lina: I'm here. First glance: Cloud metrics show ENI flaps in us-west-2a around 09:08 UTC, repeated route removals from the peering route table. Could be an AZ-level networking instability or underlying host issue.

sre_oncall_jordan: Confirming customer impact: support dashboard shows ~40% of requests to customer-service-proxy times out (503/connection-reset). Affected path: customer PrivateLink endpoint -> our service ENI in us-west-2a. Other AZs (us-west-2b/c) look healthy.

support_amy: Received escalation from the customer's ops: "we're seeing 503s and elevated latency starting ~09:10 UTC, impacting checkout flows." I told them we're investigating and will update every 10m.

eng_platform_tom: Pulling VPC peering state and route tables now. Running quick queries:
```
# check peering connection status
aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections --filters Name=status-code,Values=active --region us-west-2
```
Output shows the peering connection active, but route propagation into the peer's route table shows intermittent withdraws.

neteng_lina: Running traceroute from our proxy in us-west-2a to customer endpoint shows drops at the local AZ gateway IP, then timeouts. Sample:
```
traceroute to 10.0.32.45 (10.0.32.45), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  0.76 ms
 2  10.0.10.5  12.34 ms  *
 3  10.0.20.3  200.45 ms  *  <-- packet loss begins
```

sre_oncall_jordan: Looks like an AZ-level packet forwarding flapping. Immediate mitigation options:
- Shift traffic away from us-west-2a (route update / DNS TTL override / failover to us-west-2b ENI)
- Recreate/force-re-attach the ENI in 2a (risky during flap)
- Open cloud provider support case and request AZ gateway check

pm_elena: Customer-facing note: short update ready once we confirm mitigation plan. Prefer shifting traffic first to reduce user impact.

eng_platform_tom: Rapid failover plan: update internal route table entries for the affected customer prefix so next-hop points to ENI in us-west-2b. For PL endpoints we have per-customer routing policy — can push a targeted change.

sre_oncall_jordan: Go for targeted route table change. @neteng_lina please coordinate and validate before applying. Keep TTL low so we can revert.

neteng_lina: Preparing terraform patch to modify route priority for the prefix. Will apply to the peering HR route table in 30s window.

support_amy: FYI I'll tell the customer we're shifting traffic to another AZ; ETA 5–10m. They'll want an RCA later.

incident-bot: Note: creating support-ticket with cloud provider (INCID-2026-177450). Severity: P1. Auto-notifying account team.

neteng_lina: Applying route change now (`apply --auto-approve`).

eng_platform_tom: Route change pushed. Validating connectivity...

sre_oncall_jordan: Post-change checks: packet loss down to ~1-2% for affected flows, p50 latency back to normal. Customer request rate drop in 503s from 40% to ~3%. Good.

customer_ops_paul: Confirmed on our side — checkout errors reduced dramatically. Thanks, team. We still see occasional 502s for a handful of requests.

neteng_lina: Those are probably in-flight connections that hit the old path; should drain. Will watch for any further ENI flaps.

eng_platform_tom: Still seeing intermittent minor route withdraws from the us-west-2a peering routes; opened the cloud ticket with logs and timestamps. Cloud support responded: "Investigating elevated fabric errors in us-west-2a. Will update within 30m."

sre_oncall_jordan: Handoff: I'm handing primary incident lead to @neteng_lina for deeper network debugging and follow-up with cloud provider. I'll remain reachable for escalation. Handoff note: mitigated user impact by failing over to us-west-2b routes; need RCA and potential automated fallback rule.

neteng_lina: Taking lead. Action items I'm tracking:
- Keep targeted route override until cloud confirms root cause (temp).
- Work with infra to consider automated AZ-avoidance policy if ENI flap rate > threshold.
- Collect packet captures and ENI state history for RCA.
- Prepare customer-facing timeline and RCA draft.

pm_elena: I'll prepare the customer status note and schedule a 1:1 with the impacted customer for postmortem. Please add timestamps and exact alerts.

support_amy: Sending customer update: "We've shifted traffic to alternate AZ to restore connectivity. Cloud provider investigating underlying network instability in us-west-2a. We'll follow up with a postmortem." They replied :thumbsup: and asked for ETA for permanent fix.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to "mitigated" — impact reduced. Still open for RCA/cleanup. Assigned INCID-2026-177450 to neteng_lina.

sre_oncall_jordan: Recommending follow-up automation: low-latency detection of ENI flap patterns, auto-route failover, and a runbook for PrivateLink peering failover. Adding to backlog.

neteng_lina: Logging final note: monitoring shows stability at +20m since failover. Will keep temporary routes for 2 hours unless cloud advises otherwise. Will update thread with cloud support case result.

customer_ops_paul: Appreciate the quick response. Please include any IP ranges/ETA when you have them so we can update our on-call.

pm_elena: Thanks everyone. Postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Closing updates on this thread once RCA published.
